summary: The team is in final launch prep for the CKGSB-IE China Going-Global report at the Tech in Asia Conference in Singapore on September 15, while simultaneously pushing Asia Start and Intelligent China promotions and resolving an Outlook lockout that has stalled access.
summaryDetail: The most urgent priority is the September 15 Singapore launch of the CKGSB-IE report: the press release needs final edits and distribution, the report webpage must go live after approval, the one-page flyer awaits a QR code, and social promotion is pending. In parallel, the marketing strategy focuses on promoting Asia Start and Intelligent China (with Berkeley as a third option), which requires finalizing target areas, auditing conversion tracking, and analyzing participant profiles and CRM leads. The knowledge website redesign is also moving forward: Joseph must share his HTML design, the team will meet for specific feedback, and Joker will implement changes, including removing the video section and incorporating BCI/BSI indices. This week, the team must also resolve the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding accounts on affected devices and confirming the backend unlock with JSB. Upcoming, LIU Xuan must send the updated email to Chen Zongchao about the Singapore activities, and Felix must share the press release for edits, all before the September 15 event.
